claims.statement: Tom Allen was for several years champion heavyweight of America.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, for several years champion heavyweight of America, new runs a saloon here on Market

claims.statement: In December 1891 Tom Allen ran a saloon on Market Street in St. Louis.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, for several years champion heavyweight of America, new runs a saloon here on Market

claims.statement: Tom Allen's saloon on Market Street is in the same block as a saloon owned by Tom Kelly, a former middleweight champion.
claims.excerpt: In the same biock with him is another

claims.statement: Ben Hogan (printed as 'tien Hogan') was matched against Tom Allen in a scheme arranged to rob Allen and his backers, carried out by a crowd of toughs.
claims.excerpt: being matched against Tom Allen ina scheme arranged to robthelatter and his backers

notes: The Hogan name is printed as 'tien Hogan' in the OCR and read as Ben Hogan. The Hogan match is a challenge, not a fight: no bout is described. The article's section on other boxers is not about Allen.
